evidence: T-0045 implements Goal #30 P1.3.6: Add migration framework for .shiki state changes.

scripts/shiki_migrations.py defines the dependency-free migration registry, migration state path .shiki/migrations/state.json, status, pending, dry-run plan, and explicit execute-gated apply behavior.
Baseline migration M-20260604-0001-baseline records the existing post-P1.3.5 Shiki layout without rewriting historical .shiki state.
.shiki/migrations/state.json records the applied baseline migration as repository-local migration evidence.
shiki migrate status, plan, and apply are exposed through scripts/shiki_cli.py.
shiki migrate apply defaults to dry-run and lists intended writes; mutation requires --execute or --i-understand.
Destructive migration policy requires --i-understand even when execution is requested.
shiki doctor reports migration registry, migration state, and pending migration findings without applying migrations.
scripts/validate_shiki.py validates migration registry IDs, dependency graph, state JSON, applied records, baseline application, manifest coverage, and migration documentation.
.shiki/manifest.json includes .shiki/migrations and .shiki/migrations/state.json as tracked required migration-state.
scripts/test_shiki_migrations.sh covers registry, state validation, CLI status/plan/apply, dry-run/execute/idempotence, destructive policy, doctor integration, and manifest staging.

docs/agents/shiki-migrations.md documents purpose, state path, migration ID format, baseline migration, dry-run / execute behavior, destructive migration policy, doctor, validator, GitHub source-of-truth relation, and repair/ledger relation.

Non-goals preserved: P1.4 governance/evidence redesign, P2 packaging/release/onboarding, runtime adapter execution engine, new provider support, Guardian policy, CCA Review Bridge semantics, branch protection, CODEOWNERS, P0.4 semantics, Node.js workflows, external migration services, and broad historical rewrites.
summary: Recorded T-0045 .shiki migration framework implementation evidence.
